findings.message:
[P1] Use Bun's test API for the new coverage

The test harness runs this file with Bun's `bun test`, but this new test uses `Deno.test` and `Deno.env`; those APIs are unavailable in the committed Bun/Node type and runtime setup, so the file fails before the test registers. Use the imported Bun `test` and `process.env` instead (`AGENTS.md:5-9,130-139`).

tests/openai-compat-part11.test.ts:1127-1129

[P2] Reject malformed slash-delimited IDs before refreshing

On a cold cache this only rejects a leading or trailing slash, so values such as `https://example` or `foo//bar` still pass through to `fetchOpenRouterModels()` even though they cannot be the documented `author/slug` catalogue ID (`src/models/openrouter-models.ts:36-42`). Validate the complete model shape before refreshing.

src/provider/openrouter.ts:72-72

summary: The routing fix is partial: the new focused test is not executable in the Bun test setup, and malformed slash-containing IDs can still trigger a cold catalogue refresh.

evidence: `src/responses-handler.ts:836` checks the OpenRouter selection before resolving the model, and `src/provider/openrouter.ts:70-75` avoids refreshes for no-slash IDs.
The required disabled-provider test in `tests/openai-compat-part11.test.ts:1127-1154` uses `Deno.test` and `Deno.env` in a Bun test suite, so it cannot register or execute.
The new guard still refreshes for malformed multi-slash values such as `https://example`, so not every non-OpenRouter-shaped ID skips the cold refresh.
